question: What is the primary goal of post-abortion care counselling in nursing practice?

options.A: Determining the exact cause of pregnancy loss
options.C: Providing emotional support and medical guidance
options.D: Filing mandatory legal reports for the hospital

explanation: Counselling aims to address both the physical recovery and emotional needs of the patient in a safe environment. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h1)

question: Why is establishing early rapport essential during post-abortion counselling?

options.A: It encourages open communication and reduces patient anxiety
options.B: It eliminates the need for a physical health assessment
options.C: It speeds up the hospital discharge paperwork process
options.D: It completely prevents any future episodes of depression

explanation: Trusting nurse-patient relationships help patients share sensitive concerns and lower their stress levels. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h1)

question: What does values clarification help a nurse achieve in clinical practice?

options.A: Recognizing personal biases to provide objective care
options.B: Converting patients to specific moral belief systems
options.D: Determining the legal status of medical procedures

explanation: Examining personal beliefs prevents professional judgments from negatively affecting patient care quality. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h2)

question: A nurse displays compassionate care during post-abortion counselling by doing which of the following?

options.A: Directing the patient to adopt specific lifestyle changes
options.B: Listening actively and respecting patient autonomy without judgment
options.C: Sharing personal opinions on the morality of the procedure
options.D: Prioritizing hospital protocols over the patient's expressed feelings

explanation: Compassionate care centers on empathy and honoring the patient's personal dignity and choices. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h2)

question: Which physical symptom requires immediate attention during a post-abortion assessment?

options.A: Light spotting that occurs intermittently for days
options.B: Excessive vaginal bleeding and severe abdominal pain
options.C: Mild fatigue lasting for several hours after rest
options.D: Low-grade headache relieved by simple hydration

explanation: Heavy bleeding and severe pain are primary indicators of dangerous post-procedure complications like hemorrhage or infection. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h3)

question: A patient presents with a fever, chills, and foul-smelling discharge after a pregnancy loss. What is the nurse's best initial action?

options.A: Report signs of potential systemic infection for immediate medical review
options.B: Advise the patient to return for a routine checkup in six weeks
options.C: Discharge the patient with instructions to take warm baths daily
options.D: Reassure the patient that foul discharge is a normal finding

explanation: Fever, chills, and foul discharge point toward infection, requiring prompt medical intervention. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h3)

question: Why should patients use sanitary pads instead of tampons following an abortion?

options.A: To prevent allergic reactions to synthetic tampon fibers
options.B: To speed up the natural contraction of uterine muscles
options.C: To reduce the risk of introducing infection into the uterus
options.D: To accurately measure the exact volume of blood lost

explanation: Tampons can carry bacteria into the recovering uterine cavity, increasing the risk of postpartum or post-abortion infection. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h4)

question: What is an expected physical finding during normal recovery after an abortion?

options.A: Light cramping and intermittent bleeding for up to two weeks
options.B: Continuous heavy clotting that fills two pads per hour
options.C: Complete absence of any vaginal discharge or spotting
options.D: Sudden high fevers accompanied by severe abdominal rigidity

explanation: Mild cramping and tapering bleeding are normal physiological parts of uterine involution after tissue evacuation. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h4)

question: How soon can ovulation return following an abortion procedure?

options.B: Within six months to a year
options.C: Only after the first normal menses

explanation: Fertility returns rapidly after pregnancy termination, necessitating prompt discussion about birth control. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h5)

question: When is the appropriate time to initiate contraceptive counselling during post-abortion care?

options.A: When the patient requests a repeat pregnancy test
options.B: During the annual routine gynecological examination
options.C: Only after the patient completes a full three-month recovery
options.D: Before the patient is discharged from the clinical setting

explanation: Initiating contraceptive discussions before discharge prevents unintended rapid repeat pregnancies. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h5)

question: Which emotion is commonly experienced by some individuals following an abortion?

options.A: Relief, grief, or sadness depending on the individual
options.B: Immediate clinical depression in all reported cases
options.C: Euphoria accompanied by hyperactivity and insomnia
options.D: Complete emotional numbness that never resolves

explanation: Emotional responses are highly individualized and span a wide spectrum of feelings. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h6)

question: Why is it important for nurses to normalize diverse emotional responses after an abortion?

options.A: It ensures that hormonal imbalances resolve without treatment
options.B: It proves that professional mental health therapy is unnecessary
options.C: It stops patients from talking about their personal experiences
options.D: It reassures patients that their feelings are valid and reduces isolation

explanation: Validating varied emotional reactions helps patients feel understood and less alone during recovery. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h6)

question: When should a nurse initiate a referral to a mental health specialist during post-abortion care?

options.A: During every routine discharge regardless of emotional status
options.B: When the patient shows signs of severe psychological trauma or depression
options.C: After the patient misses a scheduled follow-up appointment
options.D: Only when the patient requests a prescription for antibiotics

explanation: Specialized mental health referrals are necessary when acute psychological distress exceeds basic nursing support. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h7)

question: What is the main benefit of connecting post-abortion patients with community support systems?

options.A: It provides long-term coping resources and reduces social isolation
options.B: It replaces the need for any follow-up physical examinations
options.C: It legally exempts the patient from hospital discharge fees
options.D: It guarantees financial assistance for all future medical bills

explanation: Community networks offer ongoing encouragement and practical coping tools well after hospital discharge. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T007#GNS226_U5_T007_h7)
